reason: The README describes a DSH Remote integration centered on a remotely accessible gateway, management console, device controls, and file-transfer endpoints, with desktop and mobile interfaces.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供带网关的远程管理插件，支持状态查看、设备与会话控制、文件传输以及桌面和移动端访问。
summaries.en: A DSH remote-management plugin that provides a gateway, status and device controls, file transfer, and desktop and mobile access.

capabilities: Runs a network gateway with Bearer-token authentication
Provides remote DSH session and device management controls
Exposes file listing, download, upload, resume, cancellation, and SHA-256 verification endpoints
Automatically starts and restarts the gateway
Provides desktop and mobile web interfaces and an Android application
Provides status, usage, request, token, and notification features
